Ki ride ki la iaid bad kiew sha jrong, kiba la dap da ki jingpyrta jong ka jingkmen, katba ki stall ialehkai ki la ai lad ban ioh khusnam bad ban rkhie. Ki nongshad ha ki jain ki nep ki la pynbyrngia ia ki paidbah da ki jinglehkai akrobatik, ki jingleh jadu, bad ki jinglehkai jingrwai, kiba la shim ia ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong baroh ki rta. Ka jingiwbih jong ki jhur jhur, ki popcorn bad ki jhur ba la shet ka la pynlong ia ki nongwan ban sngewbha. Katba nang miet, ki jingshai ba rben bad ki jingrwai ki pynlong ia ka jinglong kaba shlur kaba rakhe ia ka jingkmen, ka jingialong kawei bad ki jingsngewbha kiba suk jong ka jingim.

Ha ka kut jong ka library kaba sngap jar, la pynshai ia kawei ka miej da ka sharak, kaba khot ia u nongpule ban duh noh ia lade ha kawei ka kot. Ki sla ki bat ia ki pyrthei jong ka jingleit lynti, ka jingtip bad ka jingsngew, kawei pa kawei ka jingkhang sha ka jingsngewthuh thymmai ne ka jingphetwir. Ka jingsngap jar kaba don sawdong ka la pynroi ia ka jingpyrkhat bad jingpyrkhat, ka jaka rieh na ka jingkulmar shabar. Hajan, ki shelf ba la pynbeit katkum ka sobjek bad u nongthoh ki la ai ia ka jingpynpaw kaba riewspah jong ka jingpyrkhat bad jingthaw jong u briew. Kane ka jaka rieh jong ka jingkwah tip ka la pyni nuksa ia ka bor ba neh jong ka jingpule kot ban ai mynsiem, ban hikai bad ban pynkylla dur.

Ka kper sohjew ka la jrong ha ki lum kiba jylliew, ki sohjew jong ka ki heh da ki sohjew kiba la ih bha kiba la khreh ban ot. Ki nongtrei ki iaid ryntih hapdeng ki lain, ki ot bad ki kheit, uwei pa uwei u sumar ia ka khyndew da ka jingsumar bad jingtbit. Ka sngi ka pynmih ia ka rong ksiar halor ka jaka kaba jyrngam, kaba pynpaw ia ki rong saw ba jyrngam bad ki rong saw ba jylliew. Ka Iyer ka la dap da ka jingiwbih ba thiang jong ki soh bad ka khyndew, kaba pynpaw ia ka jinglong tynrai jong ka jingim rep. Katba ka aiom ot ka nang jan, ka jingkhmih lynti ka la nangroi ia ki wain kiba dang sah ban shna na kine ki kynhun ba kordor.

Ka shnong kaba la tap da u slap ka long ka dur kaba paka bha ha ka por lyiur, da ki tnum iing kiba la tap da ka jain lieh bad ki ice kiba la jrong na ki tnum iing. Ki surok ki la sngap jar, la pynjah rngai da ka jinghap jem jong u slap, kaba la pynmih ia ka jingshong shngain kaba suk. Ki khynnah ki shna ia ki briew sniehdoh bad ki ialehkai sniehdoh, ka jingrkhie jong ki ka sawa lyngba ka Iyer kaba rkhiang. Ki jingshai ba rkhiang na ki iing rit bad ki dukan ki iapher itynnad bad ki jaka ba khriat sawdong, ki pynmih ia ka jingsngew ba shngain. Ka jaka baroh kawei ka la long kumba ka tyngshain da ka jingleh jadu jong ka aiom, kaba khot ia baroh ban pdiang ia ka jingsuk jong ka por lyiur.

Ha ka nongbah kad lieng kaba jylliew bha, ki lieng kit mar bad ki lieng tong dohkha ki iaid lyngba ha ka kad lieng, ki mast jong ki ki poi sha bneng. Ki nongtrei kad liengsuin ki iaid stet, ki kit bad pynhap ia ki mar kiba pynkhih ia ka ioh ka kot jong ka nongbah bad kiba pyniasoh ia ka bad ka pyrthei kaba heh. Ki stall iew harud ka kad lieng ki la ai ia ki dohkha ba thymmai, ki jingshna kti, bad ki jingkynmaw na ka bynta ki nongleit jingleit bad ki nongshong shnong kumjuh. Ka jingiwbih jong ka um mluh, ki dohkha bad ka diesel ba la khleh lang ha ka Iyer, kaba pynpaw ia ka jinglong ba im jong ka jingim ha duriaw. Katba ki lieng ki nang iaid ne nang poi, ka nongbah ka nangroi ha ka jingleit jingwan, ka khaii pateng bad ka jingkhih kaba neh jong ka duriaw.

Ka jingstad ban shet jingshet ka la pyndap ia ka jaka shet jingshet da ka jingiwbih kaba thiang bad kaba khot sngewbha kaba khot ia ki nongleit nongwan shapoh. Ia ki kpu bad ki jingbam ba la shet thymmai la pynbeit ryntih da ka jingstad ha ki jaka pyni, ki tduh ksiar bad ki tduh ba jem jong ki ki pynshoi ia ki jingsngew. Ki nongshet kpu ki la pyrta katba ki dang shet ia ka doh bad shna ia ki kpu, ka jingtbit jong ki ka paw ha man la ki bynta. Ki nongthied ki la sngewtynnad ïa ka jinglong kaba suk, ki la dih ïa ki jingbam ryngkat bad ka kophi ne ka sha, ki la ïasam ïa ki jingïakren halor ki jingbam ba la shet. Kane ka kam shet jingshet kam shym la pyndap pynbiang tang hynrei ka la pyniasoh ruh ia ki briew lyngba ka dustur, ka jingthaw jingmut, bad ka jingkmen kaba suk jong ka jingbam kaba bha.

Hapdeng ka jingtrei kaba jylliew, ki nongtrei kti ki la trei shitom ha ki projek jong ki, kawei pa kawei ka bynta ka pynpaw ia ka jingtbit bad jingsngewtynnat. Ki tiar ki long naduh ki dieng bad ki nar haduh ki jain bad ka dewbilat, ha kaba ki nongtrei kti ki pynkylla ia ki tiar ba thymmai sha ka art kaba treikam. Ki sur jong ki nar, ki nar bad ki nar ki iasoh lang ha ka jingrwai jong ka jingthaw. Ki nongwan jngohkai ki sngewtynnad ia ka jingtrei kti, bunsien ki shah pynshlur ban bud ia la ki jong ki kam shna jingshna. Ka jingtrei ka la long ka jingpynshisha ia ka jingstad jong u briew bad ka jingpynsngewtynnat kaba neh jong ki tiar ba la shna da ka kti, kiba don jingmut.

Ha kane ka tamasa kaba itynnad, ki float kiba la pynitynnad da ki syntiew bad ki jingshai ki la iaid lyngba ki surok, da kaba rakhe ia ka kolshor bad ka mynsiem iatreilang. Ki nongshad ha ki jain ki nep ki la shad bad tem jingrwai, kaba la pynsngewtynnad ia ki nongpeitkai jong baroh ki rta. Ki stall die jingbam ki ai ia ki jingbam tynrai, ki iasam ia ki jingbam na ki pateng kiba la leit noh. Ka Iyer ka la rkhie bein da ka jingkmen, ka jingrkhie bad ka jingkmen lang jong ka jingiashim bynta. Katba ka miet ka nang jan, ki jingpynbthei ding ki la pynshai ia ka bneng, kaba pyni ia ka jingkut jong ka jingjia kaba sngewtynnad bad kaba sah jingkynmaw kaba la pynlong ia ki briew ban iawan lang ha ka jingrakhe.

Ka jaka nongkyndong kaba sngap jar ka la long ka jingkyntur jong ki lyngkha bad ki khlaw, ha kaba ka por ka i kumba ka nang slem. Ki nongrep ki sumar ia ki jingthung jingtep bad ki jingri jingdup, ki rukom leh jong ki ki shong tynrai ha ki spah snem jong ka riti dustur. Ki shnong kiba rit kiba don hapdeng ki jingthung jingtep, ryngkat bad ki iing rit kiba pynmih ia ka jingitynnad kaba itynnad. Ki sur ba jem jong ka mariang — ki sim kiba rwai, ka Iyer kaba beh lyngba ki sla, ka jingsawa jong ka masi kaba jngai — ki la thaw ia ka sur kaba pynjem mynsiem. Kane ka jaka kaba itynnad ka la ai ka jingjahthait na ka jingkhihwin jong ka jingim sor, kaba pynkynmaw ia ki nongwan jngohkai ia ka jingsuk bad jinglong kaba suk kaba la shem ha ka jingpdiang sngewbha jong ka mariang.

Ha ka hospital kaba mynta, ki nongtrei ka koit ka khiah ki la trei shitom ban sumar ia ki nongpang, ka jingaiti lut jong ki ka paw ha man la ka jingleh. Ka jaka kaba khlem khun ka la long ka jaka treikam, ha kaba ki nurse bad ki doktor ki pynïaid ïa ki jingsumar bad peit bniah ïa ki dak kiba kongsan. Ka jingstad ba thymmai ka la pynsuk ia ka jingpeit bniah bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah, kaba pynpaw ia ka jingiakynduh jong ka jingsngewrit bad ka jingpynwandur thymmai. Ki nongpang ki shem jingpyntngen ha ka jingtbit bad jingbhabriew jong ki nongtrei, da kaba shaniah ha ka jingthmu jong ki ban pynphai biang ia ka koit ka khiah bad ka jingbha jingmiat. Kane ka jaka ka la long ka jingpynshisha ia ka jinglah ban shah jong u briew bad ka jingwad ia ka jingpynkhiah kaba iai bteng.

Ka ri khlaw ka la jrong khlem kut, ka jaka kaba heh bha jong ki lum dewbilat bad ki lum mawsiang hapoh ka sngi kaba rben. Ki Cacti bad ki jingthung kiba khlain bor ki la bat skhem ia ka jingim ha kane ka mariang kaba eh, ka jinglah ban shah jong ki ka la pynmih ia ka jingtieng. Ki nongleit jingleit ki iaid lyngba ia ka jaka da kaba husiar, ki tip ia ki jingma bad ka jingitynnad kiba iasoh lang ha kane ka ri khlaw. Ki mirage ki tyngshain ha kaba jngai, ki jingpynbyrngia kiba lehkai ha ki khmat hynrei ki pynkhraw ia ka jingmaïan jong ka jaka. Ka jingsep jong ka sngi ka la pynkylla ia ka ri khlaw sha ka canvas jong ki rong saw bad ki rong jyrngam ba rben, ka jingshai kaba lyngkot jong ka bor ba thymmai jong ka mariang bad ka jingitynnad ba phylla.

Ka ïing rit kaba itynnad kaba don hapdeng ki dieng kiba jrong ka la ai ka jaka rieh na ka pyrthei shabar. Ki jaka thang ding ki la bthei, ki la pynmih ia ka jingshai kaba rben kaba pyndap ia ka jingpynitynnad kaba rit. Ki nongwan ki la ia shongthait bad ki kot ne ki jingiathuhkhana ba la iasam, ki da sngewbha ia ka jingsuk jong ka jingshongthait jong ki. Shabar, u slap u la hap jem jem, u la tap ia ka jaka da ka rong lieh, katba hapoh, ka jingshit bad jingsuk ka la synshar. Kane ka jinglong kaba jan ka la pynpaw ïa ka jingphaidien sha ka jinglong kaba suk bad ka jingpyntngen kaba la shem ha ka jingpdiang sngewbha jong ka mariang, ka jaka phetwir kaba janai bha na ka bynta ka jingjahthait bad jingpynthymmai.

Ha ka jaka peitkai jong ka sor kaba jylliew, ki nongialehkai ki la pynkhreh shadien, ka nerve bad ka jingkmen jong ki ka paw shynna. Ka kynhun tem ka la pynbeit ia ki tiar tem jong ki katba ki jingsawa bad ki jingkren lyngkot ki la pyndap ia ka jaka shong. Ynda la kiew ka jingtap, ka madan ka la kylla long ka pyrthei jong ka drama, ka jinglehkai, ne ka jingsngewsih, kaba pynsngewtynnat ia ki nongpeitkai bad kaba pynmih ia ki jingkynthoh ba kynja mynsiem. Ka jingiatylli jong ka jinglehkai — ki nongialehkai, ki nongtem, ki nongtrei stage — ka la thaw ia ka jingtrei ba phylla kaba lyngkot kaba la don tang ha kata ka khyllipmat. Katba ka jingshad kaba khatduh ka dang kut bad ki jingshad kti ki nang bthei, ka jingleh jadu jong ka theatre ka la pynkynmaw ia baroh ia ka bor jong ka jingiathuhkhana bad ka jingpynpaw briew.

Ka phyllaw jong ka monastery kaba suk ka la long ka jaka jong ka jingpyrkhat bad ka jingsuk. Ki monk ki iaid sngap jar lyngba ki iingmane, ki sumar ia ki kper bad ki pynkhreh ia ki jingduwai man ka sngi. Ka jingiwbih jong ka jingiwbih bad ki syntiew kiba phuh ka la pyndap ia ka jinglong ba kynja mynsiem, ka la pynroi ia ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bad ka jingsuk. Ki nongwan jngohkai ne ki nongshong shnong ki shem jingpyntngen ha ka jinglong kaba suk bad kaba ryntih jong ka jingim monaster, ha kaba ka jingpyrkhat bad ka imlang sahlang ki iasoh lang. La pynshong nongrim ha ka dustur kaba la rim da ki spah snem, kane ka jaka kyntang ka la tyrwa ia ka jaka rieh na ka bynta ka mynsiem hapdeng ka jingkulmar jong ka pyrthei shabar.

Ha ka jaka shna kaba bunkam, ki nongtrei ki la pyniadei ia ki jingpyrshang ban tei ia ka jingtei kaba thymmai, uwei pa uwei u la noh synniang ia la ka jong ka jingstad. Ka jingsawa jong ki nar bad ka jingsawa jong ki mashin ka pyni ia ka jingkiew, katba ki kyndon jingiada ki pynlong ia baroh ban long kiba lait im. Ki tiar ki la poi ha ka lynti kaba stet — ka konkrit, ki nar, ki maw — kawei pa kawei ka bynta kaba donkam eh na ka bynta ka jinglong ba janai jong ka projek. Ki nongshna ïing bad ki enjiniar ki la khmih ïa ka kam, da kaba pynthikna ba ïa ka jingshna ïing la pynurlong da ka jingshaniah. Ka jaka ka la long ka jingpynshisha ia ka jingangnud jong u briew bad ka jingiatreilang kaba donkam ban pynkylla ia ki jingthmu sha ka jingshisha.

Ka rud duriaw kaba jylliew ka la dap da ki jingim hapoh ka sla jong ka um duriaw kaba khuid. Ki skul jong ki dohkha kiba itynnad ki la iaid lyngba hapdeng ki tnat kor, katba ki blang duriaw kiba itynnad ki la iaid lyngba. Ka jinglong jingman jong ka reef kaba jylliew ka la kyrshan ia ki jait jingthaw kiba bun jait, uwei pa uwei u don ka bynta kaba kongsan ha kaba pynneh ia ka jinglong ryntih. Ki nongleit jngi bad ki nongleit jngi ki la leit jngoh ia kane ka paradais hapoh um, da kaba sngewlyngngoh ia ka jingitynnad bad jingpher jong ka. Ka jingïada ïa kine ki jaka ba rit paid ka long kaba kongsan bha ban pynneh pynsah ïa ka jingriewspah jong ki jingthaw ba im ha duriaw na ka bynta ki pateng ban wan.

Ha ka tempi Buddhist kaba shngain, ki monk ki la leh ia ki jingleh niam bad ki jingpyrkhat, kaba la pynlong ia ka jinglong kaba jemnud bad kaba pynleit jingmut ha ka jinglong mynsiem. Ka jingiwbih jong ka jingiwbih ka la bthei lyngba ka Iyer katba ki jingrwai ki la sawa jem jai, kaba ialam ia ki nongleh shapoh. Ki mot bad ki dur jong ki blei ki la ai ki jaka pdeng na ka bynta ka jingduwai bad jingpyrkhat, kaba pynroi ia ka jingsngew jong ka jingiadei bad ka jingburom. Ki nongwan jngohkai kiba wad ia ka jingsuk bad jingshemphang ki shem jingpyntngen ha ka jinglong shngain jong ka tempi kaba khlem kut por. Kum kine ki jaka kyntang ki la long kum ki jaka rieh na ka bynta ka jingwad bniah kaba shapoh bad ban rep ia ka jingsngewrit.

Ka jaka ski kaba itynnad ka la dap da ka jingkhihwin katba ki nongleit ski bad ki nongleit ski ki dang iaid ha ki lum ba jylliew bad ki lynti lum. Ki shuki lift ki rah ia ki nongwan sha ki lum, kiba ai ia ka jingpeit ba itynnad ia ka jaka ba la tap da u slap. Hadien ka sngi jong ka jingleit jngohkai pyrthei, ki nongwan jngohkai ki la ia lum ha ki ïing sah kiba itynnad, ki la ïasam khana bad ki la pynkhriat ïalade da ki ding kiba bthei. Ka jingiwbih jong ka chocolate kaba shit bad ki jingbam ba thiang ka la pyndap ia ka Iyer, kaba la pynmih ia ka jingkmen kaba bud. Kane ka madan ialehkai ha ka por lyiur ka la long ka jingrakhe ia ka jingsngewtynnad, ka mariang, bad ka jingiadei paralok, kaba la thaw ia ki jingkynmaw kiba neh slem hadien ba u slap u la rkhiang.

Hapoh ka laboratory kaba stad bha, ki stad saian ki la pynlong ia ki jingpyrshang da kaba pyrkhat bha, da kaba shaniah ha ka jinglong kaba thikna bad ka jingstad. Ki tiar ki tyngshain hapoh ki jingshai kiba rben katba ki dang bishar bniah ia ki nuksa bad ki buh jingthoh ia ki jingtip, ki wad jingtip shaphang ka pyrthei mariang ne ki jingkiew ha ka juk stad saian. Ka jingiatreilang bad ka jingkwah tip ka la pynlong ia ka kam jong ki, bunsien ka la ialam sha ki jingpynkylla kiba lah ban ktah bha ia ka imlang sahlang. Ka mariang ka la long ka jingkhleh lang jong ka jingpynbeit ba la tehlakam bad ka jingwad bniah khlem pud, kaba pynpaw ia ka mynsiem briew jong ka jinglap bad jingpynwandur thymmai. Kawei pa kawei ka jingmih ka la noh synniang sha ka jingwad kaba kham heh ia ka jingsngewthuh bad ka jingkiew shaphrang.

Ka dukan kot kaba itynnad ha ka Main Street ka la khring ia ki nongieit kot da ka dur khmat kaba khot sngewbha bad ki jingbuh kot kiba la bthei da ki kot lyngkdop. Ki nongpule ki la wad ia ki jinglum jingtip ba la buh ryntih bha, ki la lap ia ki nongthoh thymmai bad ki kot ba rim kiba khlem kut por kumjuh. Ka jingiwbih jong ki kot kiba la tymmen ka la tap ia ki nongwan jngohkai, ka la pynkhraw ia ka jingsngewbha ba lah ban ktah ban lap ia ki khanatang bad ki jingtip. Ki nongtrei kiba sngewbha ki la ai jingmut, da kaba pyndap ïa ka jingktah ba kyrpang ïa ka jingïakynduh. Kane ka jaka rieh na ka bynta ka thoh ka tar ka la pynroi ia ka imlang sahlang, ka jingmutdur bad ka jingpule, ka la pynroi ia ki jingiadei hapdeng ki kyntien bad kito kiba sumar ia ki.

Ha ka kper jingthung kaba heh bha, la pyni ia ki jingthung kiba jyrngam na kylleng ka pyrthei ha ki bynta ba la pynbeit bha. Ki lynti ki iaid lyngba ki jaka thung syntiew kiba itynnad, ki pung kiba suk, bad ki jaka thung dieng kiba don jingdum, kiba khot ia ka jingwad bniah bad ka jingsuk. Ki nongrep ki sumar da ka jingieit ia uwei pa uwei u jingthung, da kaba pynthikna ia ka jingpynneh pynsah ia ki jait jingthung kiba duna bad ia ka jingitynnad jong ka jaka. Ki nongwan jngohkai ki la sngewphylla ia ka jingpher jong ki jingthung jingtep, ki la tip shaphang ka jingiadei jong ki mariang bad ki buit rep. Ka kper ka la long kum ka jaka rieh na ka bynta ki nongtip bad ki nongwan thymmai kumjuh, ka jingtap kaba im jong ka jingphylla jong ka mariang bad ka jingstad jong u briew.

Ka jaka lehkai kaba jylliew ka la ai ia ki jingsngewtynnad bad jingkmen ryngkat bad ki kali iaid kai, ki kali Ferris bad ki jingialehkai jong ka. Ki jingshai kiba shai bad ki jingrwai kiba sngewtynnad ki la pynlong ia ka jinglong kaba shlur kaba la khring ia ki paidbah na jan bad na jngai. Ki khynnah bad ki rangbah kumjuh ki la mad ia ki por jong ka jingkmen bad jingsngewbha, da kaba shim ia ki jingkynmaw hapdeng ka jingsngewbha bad jinglehkai. Ki jaka ieng ba ai jingbit ki la pynbiang ïa baroh naduh ki jingbam cotton haduh ki jingbam ba bang, kaba pynshlur ïa ka jingïaid lynti kaba bteng. Kane ka jinglehkai bad jingrkhie ka la rakhe ia ka jinglong kaba suk bad kaba sngewbha jong ka jinglehkai khlem jingkhuslai, kaba pynkynmaw ia baroh ia ka jingkmen kaba la shem ha ki jingshem ba iasam lang.

Ha ka ïingsah nongkyndong kaba suk, ki nongwan ki la ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait kaba suk na ka jingkhihwin jong ka jingim kaba man la ka sngi. Ki jingpynbeit ba itynnad bad ki jingshai ba rkhiang ki la pynlong ïa ka jinglong kaba sngewtynnad, katba ki jingbam ba thiang ki la ai jingsuk bad jingbam. Ka jaka sawdong ka pyni ia ki lyngkha kiba jylliew bad ki khlaw kiba jem, kiba biang bha ban iaid kai bad ban pyrkhat jylliew. Ka jingpdiang sngewbha jong u trai ïing ka pynlong ïa ki nongwan jngohkai ban sngew ba ki don ha ïing jong ki bad ban sngew ba ki don ha ïing. Kane ka jaka rieh jong ka jinglong kaba suk bad ka mariang ka la ai ka jingsangeh kaba pynthymmai, kaba pyniasoh biang ia ki nongleit jingleit bad ka jinglong kaba kham slem bad kaba kham thmu jong ka jingim nongkyndong.

Ka jaka buh jingthoh kaba itynnad bad kaba mynta ka la pyni ia ki jingpyni bapher bapher jong ka art, ka histori bad ka saian. Ki nongwan jngohkai ki la iaid lyngba ki jingpyni ba la pynkhreh bha, da kaba iatreilang bad ki bynta ba iadei bad ki panel kiba ai jingtip. Ka jingtei hi ka long ka kam shna dur, kaba pynrung ia ka jingpynwandur kaba thymmai ban pyndap ia ki jingpyni kiba don hapoh. Ki prokram ai jinghikai bad ki jingïalang ba kyrpang ki la pynroi ïa ka jingkwah tip bad ka jingnang jingstad. Ka jaka buh jingthoh ka la long kum ka jingkieng kaba pyniasoh ia ka mynnor, ka mynta bad ka lawei, kaba la pynshlur ia ki nongwan jngohkai ban sngewnguh ia ka jingstad bad jingstad jong u briew ha kylleng ki jait jingpule.

Halor ka tduh lum kaba sngap jar, kawei ka iingmane kaba rit ka peit sha ka jaka sawdong, ka tnum jong ka ka poi sha bneng. Ki nongleit jingleit bad ki nongwan jngohkai ki wan ban wad jingpyntngen, ban duwai, ne tang ban sngewbha ia ki jingitynnad ba itynnad. Ki kynroh maw bad ki jingtei kiba suk hapoh ki pynpaw ia ka jinglong rit mynsiem bad jingburom, ki pynroi ia ki por jong ka jingpyrkhat bad jingiadei. Ka jaka ka long ka jingpynkynmaw ia ka jingwad jong u briew kaba neh ia ka jingroi bad jingsngewthuh ba kynja mynsiem. Ha ka por ba sep ka sngi, ka ïingmane ka la paw kum ka sharak jong ka jingkyrmen bad jingsuk hapdeng ka jingheh jong ka mariang.
